notes: Blowing up a house is a physics destruction sandbox, which this taxonomy files under Simulation — its Physics Sim subgenre is breakable assemblies whose reactions are the entertainment, and physics-rig is the house itself. I took space-bounded from the shared catalogue rather than any of Simulation's typical shapes: a single suburban home and its lot is one bounded single-level space, where the preset's world-open would promise a contiguous explorable map that is the opposite of one target house. Because I swapped the preset's shape and also dropped hazard-kill and path-circulation as unasked-for, the build no longer counts as Physics Sim and the preset is none, with that preset named here as the lineage. The author settled the two open calls: destroyed from outside only, so no building-interior and no P3, and flattened as fast as possible, so the run ends when the house is rubble rather than at any placed goal.
